enhanced_information: Deficiency in C4 is associated with an impaired clearance of immune complexes, leading to an increased risk of autoimmune diseases. Specifically, deficiency in C4 has been linked to systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) due to the activation of the classical complement pathway, resulting in tissue damage and inflammation. This association is supported by evidence paths showing that antigen-antibody complexes can lead to symptoms and pain, ultimately contributing to autoimmune diseases.
